verdict.rationale: Skyvern offers self-hosting (docs-2, docs-12) which gives infrastructure-level control over where data lives, and it captures artifacts (recordings, screenshots, network traffic) per run (docs-11), implying some data exists to manage, but there is no documented retention policy, data deletion API/UI, or export/purge controls for the cloud/hosted product. missing for 10: explicit data retention policy, user-facing deletion/export controls, documentation on how long artifacts/credentials are stored in cloud mode, and independent confirmation that self-hosting actually eliminates vendor-side data retention.
